population.name: Universal Dependencies Japanese GSD
population.annotationCaveat: GSD retains contributed manual annotations, while its current short-unit word conversion and some UD fields are converted from the Japanese source annotation. UniDicInfo is independent corpus evidence but shares UniDic lineage with SudachiDict, so engine-specific error review accompanies aggregate scores.

splits.role: exploratory candidate-output holdout; not decision evidence because the complete protocol/truth was not yet committed
splits.name: test

confirmationHoldout.selectionRule: 512 records with lexicographically lowest SHA-256(domain || UTF-8 sent_id)
confirmationHoldout.candidateExecution: Exactly once after the freeze commit

externalDomainCheck.name: Universal Dependencies Japanese PUD
externalDomainCheck.role: external-domain surprise check; never adapter tuning

scoring.primarySegmentation: UD Japanese GSD short-unit word spans
scoring.allowedAlternatives: Only alternatives explicitly authored in the Zenbu hard-case manifest before provider execution
scoring.boundaryEdges: Token end offsets excluding transcript start and end
scoring.fieldEligibility: Lemma, reading, and coarse POS are scored on exact gold spans and also end-to-end with boundary failures counted wrong
scoring.readingAgreement: A provider reading agrees when it equals either the independently retained UniDic lexeme reading or surface pronunciation; both literals are frozen before holdout so orthographic long-vowel and phonetic long-mark forms are not mistaken for analyzer errors
